2023-08-26
First notice of loss was received for a low-speed head-on collision involving the insured vehicle. The cliamant reports
neck pain and was transported from the scene, and the claim has been assigned for review.
2023-08-31
Police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The driver listed on the policy is the
person who reported the loss, and the policy was in force on the date of loss.
2023-11-19
Photographs taken at the scene show the front-end damage on both vehicles, and the damage pattern is consistent
with the described impact. No independent witnesses have been identified, so the photos are the main independent
record of the collision.
2023-12-17
Claimant is represented by counsel, and all contact is now routed through the attorney's office. A recorded sattement
was requested and the claimant's account has been consistent across each conversation to date.
2023-12-27
Medical records were received showing a diagnosis of whiplash, which fits the mechanism and force of a collision of
this type. No prior injury to the neck or upper back appears in the records reviewed.
2024-01-13
Vehicle records show no earlier damage to the front end, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the
coverage start. Repair estimate has been reviewed and the scope of work matches the impact described.
2024-02-22
Treatment followed a typical course of physical therapy and has tapered as the claimant's symptoms improved. File
remains open pending receipt of the final treatment summary and the attorney's demand package.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
